header.headline: Terms of use
header.subhead: The rules for using konsenxia.com and the content published on it.

sections.title: Acceptance
sections.body: By using this website you agree to these terms. Separate commercial terms govern any product engagement; those agreements take precedence over these website terms.

sections.title: Not medical advice
sections.body: Content on this website — including descriptions of consultation, differential diagnosis, and drug analytics modules — is product information for professional evaluation. It is not medical advice, not a diagnosis tool for public use, and not a substitute for a licensed clinician's judgement. Status labels on this site (architecture, roadmap) indicate documentation state, not clinical validation.

sections.title: Site content
sections.body: Text, design, and code on the landing repository are provided under the licenses stated on the Licenses page. Product names, logos, and non-open components remain the property of their owners.

sections.title: Status labels
sections.body: Statements marked architecture reflect documented design (sources: docs/healthcare_ai_architecture.md, docs/legal/*). Statements marked roadmap describe intent. "Designed for" anonymization is not a certification. No clinical performance figure is published without methodology, source, date, and status.

sections.title: Acceptable use
bullets: No unlawful, harmful, or deceptive use of the site.
No submission of patient or identifiable case data through website forms.
No use of site content to present unverified clinical or compliance claims.
No scraping that degrades availability, and no bypassing access controls.

sections.title: Limitation of liability

sections.title: Third-party links

sections.title: Changes & contact
sections.body: We may update these terms; the date at the top reflects the latest revision. Questions go through the contact page.
